IC1: - Age 13-17 years [OR] or 18-20 if still living at home with parent.
IC2: - Agreement of at least one responsible adult parent/caregiver to participate in treatment.
IC3: - Agreement to take part in assessments, videotaping/audiotaping and coding of their sessions by research personnel.
IC4: - Agreement to pay for mental health services at the DBT- RU on a sliding scale, and to participate in research assessments as volunteers.
IC5: - Residence within commuting distance of clinic (< 45 minutes).
IC6: - Agreement to [NOT] discontinue other forms of talk therapy for duration of DBT program (does not refer to AA/ [OR] NA programs [OR] or psychotropic medication management).
IC7: - Exhibits dysregulation within the past six months as evidenced by 1) intentional self-injury [OR] and/or suicide attempt [OR] and/or 2) substance use disorder.
IC8: - Meets two additional criteria for borderline personality disorder (BPD).
